about: One kit language for every primitive and assembly. Dimensions in metres, Z up, front faces -Y. Colours are LINEAR RGB. Derived from the MW5/MWO artist references (Godfrey Urban Warfare, Halim MW5 sets) and the stock MC2 textures; see docs/scifi-kit-art-review.md.

grid.basis: 3m bay, 0.75m panel subdivision. Every primitive's width is a multiple of sub_m, so seams, plinth joints and coping joints meet across parts.

chamfer.basis: Godfrey: 45-degree chamfers on the primary masses, small chamfers on trims; no rounded bevels.

plinth.basis: Ferrocrete base course shared by every grounded part

base_band.basis: Single thin accent band where the cladding meets the plinth (Godfrey C6 / Halim spacetower)

reveal.basis: Every opening sits in a chamfered reveal cut into a wall; openings never float

wood.base: timber cases, directional grain, fade and water dirt

canvas.base: olive woven canvas, sewn folds and chalky fade

paint.base: painted metal; wears to primer then bare steel

corr.base: corrugated sheet, painted or rusted; real corrugation geometry

ferro.base: ferrocrete; cracks, rust bleed from rebar, chips on edges

char.base: torn edges and burned interior, destroyed only

tripod_stock.source: Stock tripodbarricade: brown brace, yellow-black crossed members

portable_stock.source: Batch two stock five-side texture study; MC2 palette

conditions.about: Parameters follow Godfrey's Substance building graph (Edge_Wear, Dirt Level, Grunge, FerrocreteRust, CrackIntensity, Glass_Cracks, Paint_On) plus fade, peel, streaks and moss for the abandoned look. Destroyed = worn weathering + local physical damage (geometry) + soot.
